fusions.name: Silk Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a strand of silk that deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a web out in a cone 4.5 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Anchored Lines
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Watcher
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded web spider that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds within 5 tiles. It leaves [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
